My great great grandmother and her dad are buried there.  I only recently learned about them from my DNA results. They immigrated from Germany when she was 2 years old to Philadelphia.  The Friends of Mount Moriah do amazing work and were able to tell exactly where she is buried. Unfortunately, when I was able to go visit it in 2021 (I live in Texas) her area was still too overgrown to find her plot.  Her name was Anna Hiel McDonald. She died in her 30s in 1901 from tuberculosis, and left behind her husband and young daughters. One of her daughters married and moved to Texas and then birthed my grandma! 

I regularly donate to the non profit to help them keep the cemetery accessible.
